sources.snippet: The library enables the training of agents directly from the screen pixels in a number of scenarios, including team deathmatch, shown in the video below. Because the ViZDoom environment is based on a game the was created in the 90s, it can be run on modern hardware at accelerated speeds, allowing us to learn complex AI behaviors fairly quickly.
